Mateusz '''"Betowen"''' F is an oldschool Polish QuakeWorld player. From [[1997]] he played QW mainly on dial-up internet connection and with ping between 200-300 he had a great time. In [[1998]] [[Image:flag_pl.gif]] [[Haggard]] asked him to join [[Image:flag_pl.gif]] [[Hard Guns Crew]] and along with [[Image:flag_pl.gif]] [[Qrush]], [[Image:flag_pl.gif]] [[Shadow]] and [[Image:flag_pl.gif]] [[Insane]] played in very first and oldest HGC 4on4 squad. Because [[Hard Guns Crew]] got deactivated in [[2000]], [[Image:flag_pl.gif]] [[Highlander]] asked him to join [[Image:flag_pl.gif]] [[Demolition Crew]]. By the end of [[2002]] he completely retired from playing QW and after over 20 years without any further practice he appeared in Radomsko LAN Party [[Image:flag_pl.gif]] [[QW LAN Party Poland 2024]]. During 2025 he tries to stay active and come back to Radomsko LAN Party in better shape.
